title: A useful and well-structured session
quote: Martin ran a well-organised session in which he utilised Zoom and its features (annotation, break out rooms) to encourage maximum participation. It was evident that the session was carefully prepared, and I took away some useful points. I think the session could have been run in a slightly shorter time-frame. Thanks Martin for being so enthusiastic and engaging yet again.
author: Chantal
subject: Soft Skills Training
